name: fileName
label: File name
help: Name of the file, with its extension. For example, `report.pdf`.

name: data
label: Data
help: Content of the PDF to take the pages from.

name: ranges
label: Pages
help: Pages to keep, as page numbers and ranges separated by commas. For example, `1-5,7,10-12`.

name: password
label: PDF password
help: Only for a PDF that asks for a password to open. The result has no password.
